physics-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-11.material: Particle P inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana $B$, ichiita uniform circular motion, radius yeorbit $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ uye period $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Particle Q inopinda zvakatwasuka mufield imwe chete, huremu hwayo $4$ ka-P, charge magnitude $2$ ka-P, uye kumhanya $3$ ka-P. Hatitariswi gravity. Ndeipi radius neperiod yaQ zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-11.thinking.0: Photoelectric effect, hunhu hwakaviri hwechiedza, nepasi diki
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Particle P inopinda zvakatwasuka mu magnetic field yakaenzana $B$, ichiita uniform circular motion, radius yeorbit $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ uye period $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Particle Q inopinda zvakatwasuka mufield imwe chete, huremu hwayo $4$ ka-P, charge magnitude $2$ ka-P, uye kumhanya $3$ ka-P. Hatitariswi gravity. Ndeipi radius neperiod yaQ zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: Sezvo $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$ iri, $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. Sezvo $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ isingaenderani nokumhanya, $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Kusiya charge ratio kunopa $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (nhema ①), kutora period seyakaenderana nokumhanya kunopa $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (nhema ③), kusatarisa mass ne charge ratios uchishandisa speed ratio chete kunopa $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (nhema ④).
physics-killer-11.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-11.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
